source.title: Make C2 runtime tick environment handling reliable
source.objective: Provide one canonical tick entrypoint that imports DBus and runtime environment once, performs the tick, and returns canonical readback. Prevent manual multi-command invocation from losing required environment context.
source.acceptance_json: ["Tick succeeds with the documented runtime environment through one entrypoint.", "Canonical readback reports whether a tick dispatched work or only renewed/acknowledged state."]
